steps.content: In the pitch-dark room, starlight filters through the window onto the floor.
The two children are not yet asleep. Sandy keeps jabbering on and on.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: By the way, that Chief seems a little simple-minded, not as cool as you described. Haha.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: A little sweet talk and I'm here now. Didn't doubt a word I said. They even let us share a room...

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: They even believed me when I said I couldn't sleep if didn't stay with you. How gullible, hahaha!
Despite Sandy's gleeful laughs, Crache's face doesn't look exactly pleasant in the dark.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I'm gullible too, aren't I?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: What? What are you talking about? Why would I...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Stop trying to change the subject. What happened to those Mania Crystals?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: I told you, it's Thou Voodoos. They were biting each other within the gang, and someone got swindled.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Got swindled by who? You? With your usual trickery for adults?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Crache! You're suspecting me!
Sandy pretends to be mad, then starts making puppy eyes.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Did that Chief say something to you? Boohoo, Crache suspects me because of some adult! My heart is bleeding!
She fusses, faking cry and trying hard not to laugh. When she reaches out to tickle Crache, she's met with a pair of icy eyes.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I don't give a damn about what he says. I just want to know if you've touched that stuff.
steps.female_content: I don't give a damn about what she says. I just want to know if you've touched that stuff.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: If the others from the Homeless have touched that stuff.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Answer me!
Crache is hidden in the shadow, but Sandy senses her friend's anger sharply.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Crache... Crache, don't be mad... I just haven't seen you for too long. I'm too happy, I got carried away.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: I, I swear to you! I'll never touch that dirty stuff from those wicked adults. We've got you with us! You know it. The Homeless will always stay together. I'll never ever lie to you!
Crache doesn't speak, so Sandy tugs at her carefully.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: I know, you're anxious because you worry about the Homeless. We're all fine. We've never touched that dangerous stuff. Everyone's okay.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: So... Don't be mad, okay? You scare me when you're like this...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...I'm not mad.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I just... want to make sure you guys are okay.
Crache's voice softens. Sandy notices and smiles contentedly. She grabs her hand and swings it in the air.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Hehe, we haven't seen each other for so long. I think we've never been apart for such a long time. Growing up, we've always been together.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: These days have been scary without you. It feels like we're back to those days when we ran errands for Yagyu.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: It was the worst time. You hadn't got your power yet, and we didn't have our Guardian to help us. Those bastards scolded and kicked us every day, just because we were powerless, because children are the weakest of all...

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Now that you're back, everything will be fine again. We'll catch a chance to escape and go back to the Homeless!

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Or I'll stop bullying that Chief. I'll treat him as a genuinely good guy. He'll let us go, right?
steps.female_content: Or I'll stop bullying that Chief. I'll treat her as a genuinely good person. She'll let us go, right?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...He is a good guy. A bit dumb, but... he's serious about helping us.
steps.female_content: ...She is a good person. A bit dumb, but... she's serious about helping us.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: He's asking around about the Mania Crystals now. He told me Thou Voodoos had taken some of the kids.
steps.female_content: She's asking around about the Mania Crystals now. She told me Thou Voodoos had taken some of the kids.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Sandy, tell me the truth.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: If you'd never touched that stuff, why was Thou Voodoos coming after you?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Why did they take our friends?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Hmm...

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Just don't get mad at me.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Say it. I won't be mad.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: To be honest... After you got caught by that Chief, I... I thought about it. I heard that Mania Crystals could turn a regular human into a Sinner...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: You...!

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Wahhh! You said you won't get mad! You weren't there, okay?! I wanted to become like you so I could protect everyone.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: You guys can't handle that stuff! You don't choose to become a Sinner. Most people just turn into monsters! And die!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: And it makes no difference even if you do turn into a Sinner, someday I might also just...!

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: No, no, no, I didn't touch it! I chickened out, alright? That's what I do, you know me, don't you?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: I only asked about it. All I did was ask Thou Voodoos about it once, and they marked me. They blame me after they failed to keep their own goods safe!

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Those adults are all the same! Calling us thieves and bad eggs, blaming everything on us! You must believe me!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: What else are you hiding from me?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Nothing else. I swear.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Everyone will be fine. They don't know about the crystals. Also, we've got that Chief on our side now, no?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: I'll take him to Thou Voodoos' base tomorrow, and he'll crush those bad guys. Once Thou Voodoos goes down, the Homeless will truly be safe.
steps.female_content: I'll take her to Thou Voodoos' base tomorrow, and she'll crush those bad guys. Once Thou Voodoos goes down, the Homeless will truly be safe.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: It's alright, Crache. Everyone's gonna be okay. You're here to protect us.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...Tsk. You should know better than to ask for trouble. I can't be there all the time.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Sleep. I'll come with you tomorrow.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Cool! I know you won't let me go alone. You're the best, Crache!
Inside the Bureau's car, Crache leans against the window, staring at the view wordlessly.
While Sandy won't stop talking.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: You know, Chief, you owe me a favor.
Oh? How so?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Don't play dumb. I told you where Thou Voodoos' nest is. If you catch them and find those Mania Crystals, it'll be a huge achievement for you, won't it?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: When you get the prize, don't forget to thank me.
Sandy says as she wriggles her eyebrows at Crache, trying to get her to play along.
That will depend on whether your information is true.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: How can you still doubt me? You're a paranoiac, aren't you? Even if you don't trust me, you must at least trust Crache?
What if you've lied to Crache too?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Crache, you see that? This one's trying to get between us even now.
Sandy shouts. Crache turns to you two, looking a little annoyed.
You sigh and decide to ask her something else instead.
What happened to the other kids from the Homeless?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: I told you. They've gone to the secret hideout where no one can find them.
No one can find them... It can't happen to be the place you use to store your loot, can it?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: That's none of your business. Are you planning to let the Executive Committee get us when this is over? I knew it, adults are all evil!
As she speaks, Sandy looks out of the window a little anxiously.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: What's wrong? You took the wrong route, didn't you?

steps.speaker: Driver
steps.content: A riot broke out recently and ruined that road. We have to take a detour.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: ...All right.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: I just have a feeling you're up to no good. You're not planning to do something bad, are you?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Whatever, I'm not afraid of you. Crache, if this one tries anything, you have to protect me.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Okay.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: He... He...
Despite your arrival, Sandy still hesitates to speak the truth.
I've worked so hard to uncover your secret hideout. You should know what this means.
The Mania Crystals are inside, am I right?

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: No... No!
You sigh at Sandy's stubborn denial.
I've given you a chance, Sandy. I've given you many chances.
Before you speak a word, the mission operatives advance in sync and open the factory's iron gate.
But it's only when you enter the factory that you realize the situation may be worse than you imagined.
There are no kids from the Homeless, no Mania Crystals.
The crude beds, tables, and chairs are all overturned. The storage racks are toppled over. Suspicious bloodstains are everywhere.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: What... What has happened?!
The worst-case scenario has happened.
In the previous operations, Thou Voodoos has always been a few steps behind you in terms of information and reaction. They were only resisting the investigation with their number.
But somehow on this critical matter, they've beaten you to it.

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Chief, we've checked the surveillance footage from the Executive Committee. Thou Voodoos were here six hours ago.

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: They took the Mania Crystals... and the kids.
Why?!

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: It could be an act of retaliation. It's also possible that... they want to use the Mania Crystals on the kids... After all, the monsters can still fight after losing their minds.
Keep tracking Thou Voodoos' whereabouts and keep me posted. Besides, tell the entire operation department that their break is over. I need them to be on standby.
The worst has happened. You rub your brow and suddenly think of something. You turn to Sandy.
Sandy... Do you know...
You're not in the mood to blame Sandy for anything. You only want to get any useful information from her.
But she looks extremely frightened and dashes toward Crache at your question.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Crache! Help!
She grips Crache's hand, praying her long-time best friend and guardian would help her again and rescue her from this hell-like scenario.
But this time, Crache shakes off her hands.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Crache...
Crache suddenly looks like a stranger to her. Sandy sees a look on her she's never seen before, a look that frightens her. She starts crying uncontrollably.
Under these circumstances, you're not going to get anything out of her.
Meanwhile, you receive a new message on your personal device.
We have their location... Inform the operation department to set off now.
Also, request support from the Executive Committee and FAC. Get as many people as possible. I don't want any missteps in this operation.
Without any hesitation, you walk outside. Crache follows you silently.
Her condition worries you indeed. You reach out a hand, then draw back.
Don't worry. Nothing will happen to them.
You try and try but still can't think of more comforting words to say to her. All you can do is repeat it once more, as if convincing yourself as well.
...I promise you, nothing will happen to them.
